residual_risks: Expired event retention depends on traffic volume: cleanupTraffic deletes at most 500 expired records and the scheduled handler invokes it once every five minutes, giving a sustained drain capacity of 100 events/minute. Above that aggregate ingestion rate the expired backlog grows indefinitely. No expected production traffic volume was available to establish whether this is a current operational defect.
testing_gaps: The storefront browser test covers direct navigation and reload with mocked identity/event endpoints, but does not exercise client-side product navigation via router links. A focused SPA navigation case should verify that page:finish observes the matching catalog-product payload and emits one product event, including returning to a previously visited product.
